attchmntText: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "CleanMax Signs MoU with Andhra Pradesh to Invest Approx INR 50,000 crore in an Integrated Clean Energy Complex to Power a 2 GW Compute Factory".
sm_name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited
voiceSummary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board to invest approximately Rs. 50,000 crore. The investment targets an integrated clean energy complex comprising 3 GW of wind and solar capacity and 1 GW of pumped storage. This infrastructure will power a 2 GW Green Compute Factory in the Kurnool District. The facility is being developed in collaboration with AI cloud provider Neysa, which will anchor the park with 1 GW of IT load. CleanMax will manage generation, storage, and distribution to provide round-the-clock green energy. At least 1.5 GW of renewable capacity is proposed to be developed by 2029. CleanMax will apply for a Distribution License from the Andhra Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission. The company also committed to social initiatives including school infrastructure upgrades and youth skilling programs.
